newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain- Soy, wheat mostly flat, corn firms.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain- Soy, wheat mostly flat, corn firms.

text.p: U.S. Gulf FOB soybean and wheat basis values were mostly steady Friday while corn firmed, export sources said. "There seems to be a reluctance to sell," an export source said.
Another export dealer agreed. "It is the holiday season. There is no business. We are kind of out of the window looking in," he said, referring to the lack of export activity.
"We are seeing action going everywhere else. For the time being, we are quiet," he said.
China bought 150,000 tonnes of Brazilian soymeal for May to September delivery, a Brazilian trader confirmed.
